text:
vikram: PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234 — addressed your comments, added the microbench numbers, and included a smoke run in the PR description. I called out the perf delta and why it's expected.
ashley: reading now. quick q — bench shows ~3% slower p95 for small payloads, is that from extra lock you mentioned earlier?
vikram: yes, small requests hit the new route guard which takes a short lock to sync KV cache priming. I added a benchmark that exercises longer sequences showing ~5% lower GPU memory and 12% better throughput for batched inference.
mike: skimmed the diff — looks good. can you paste the bench command you ran so I can replicate locally?
vikram: sure:
```
# run microbench for small payloads
./scripts/bench --model gpt-small --seq 64 --concurrency 8 --iters 200
# run batch throughput
./scripts/bench --model gpt-small --seq 512 --concurrency 64 --iters 100
```
vikram: also added a short note in PR about the fallback policy if the guard triggers (it keeps old path for 2 releases if we see >2% regression on production metrics).
ashley: ok that fallback helps. can we add a quick CI smoke that runs the small payload bench variant in the linux-infra job? avoids surprises.
vikram: added a workflow in .github/workflows/smoke-bench.yml — it runs the small payload bench only on PRs labelled smoke. CI logs are attached to the PR.
ci-bot: smoke-bench (linux-infra) passed — logs: https://ci.internal/logs/4967804321/1 :white_check_mark:
mike: :thumbsup: from me. no blocking comments.
sam: thanks — leaving merge timing to eng oncall. Vikram, can we hold merge until tomorrow 10:00am PT so platform can reserve a canary slot?
vikram: yep holding. updated the PR description with canary window note and added a changelog entry.
ashley: LGTM aside from one nit in the comment, asked to fix inline but not blocking. PTAL again after small nit.
vikram: fixed nit and pushed. PTAL.
ashley: looks good now, approving. :white_check_mark:
sam: noted — will merge at 10:00am PT tomorrow unless anyone flags an issue. Thanks all!
